title: Concession in an Essay: jóllehet, noha, ámbár, holott
grammar: Concession in an Essay: jóllehet, noha, ámbár, holott
goal: I can concede a point in an essay with jóllehet, noha or ámbár.
I can use holott to criticise a contradiction between what someone knew and what they did.
I can weigh an argument with words such as megalapozott, vitatott and megcáfol.

sections.title: Unit 1: The Architecture of Argument & Logical Cohesion
body: Now fluency grows into argument. It is no longer enough to string sentences together accurately; you must orchestrate ideas, build multi-clause premises, and guide the listener through nuanced concessions and decisive counter-arguments.

In this unit, inspired by Mihály Babits' seminal 1928 essay 'Az írástudók árulása' (The Treason of the Intellectuals), you will master high-register concessive connectors (jóllehet, ámbár, noha, holott, mindazonáltal), balanced correlatives, and the syntactic architecture of academic and essayistic Hungarian.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can concede a point in an essay with jóllehet, noha or ámbár.
I can use holott to criticise a contradiction between what someone knew and what they did.
I can weigh an argument with words such as megalapozott, vitatott and megcáfol.
